property_summary: For any two distinct LogFile addresses A and B, after the reference contract is initialized via SetLogFile(A) and Initialized(), a second SetLogFile(B) must revert and leave LogFile equal to A; the mutant removes the guard and lets the address change to B.
change_summary: Delete the guard `if(intitalized)revert();` before assigning Log so SetLogFile no longer reverts after initialization.
